name: Paul
note: The apostle (in the traditional view), writing with Silvanus and Timothy and signing in his own hand (3:17).

name: Silvanus
note: Paul's co-worker (Silas), named in the greeting.

name: Timothy
note: Paul's younger co-worker, named in the greeting.

name: The believers in Thessalonica
note: Faithful under persecution, but unsettled by a rumor and by some who had stopped working.

name: The Lord Jesus
note: Who will be revealed from heaven and give relief to the afflicted.

name: Those who afflict the church
note: People who did not know God and did not obey the gospel, to whom God will repay affliction (1:6, 1:8).

name: The man of lawlessness
note: A figure who will rebel against God and exalt himself before the Lord comes (2:3-9); who or what he is has been debated for centuries.

name: The idle
note: Some in the church who "walk disorderly," not working but meddling (3:6-12).

name: Satan
note: Whose activity is behind the lawless one's works (2:9) and from whom the Lord protects believers (3:3).
